name: 1983 Renault R11 Turbo
reasons: NO SHEET - rejected pre-render by gpu_wave's local pose gate, so this verdict is from the source GLB geometry, not from an eye review of a render
geom_audit: flipped/on-side (tob=0.02) and floorpan/wreck (h/l=0.018) - the source mesh is not an upright whole car

name: Renault Captur
reasons: TYRE COLOUR: at 4x the tyre is the same flat mid-grey as the alloy - one untextured grey material over rim and tyre, does not read as black rubber
otherwise good: Captur Mk1 proportions correct, glazing reads as glass, rim spokes present all four views

name: RENAULT Estafette MICHELIN
reasons: baked third-party Michelin livery in the texture - cannot be resprayed or shipped as a neutral catalogue car
sliding side door modelled open; Michelin-man figurine on the roof
geometry itself clean: black rubber tyres, real glass, rim faces present

name: Renault Megane CC

panels see-through; no premium paint finish possible

name: Renault Scenic
reasons: no body-paint material (mats=0, cov=0.000) - whole car renders as smoked translucent glass, panels see-through
cannot be resprayed; reads as a prototype shell, not a car

name: Renault Symbol
reasons: no body-paint material (mats=0, cov=0.000) - whole car renders as smoked translucent glass/chrome
panels read see-through; no premium paint finish possible
tyres do not read as black rubber - wheels are glassy blobs

name: Renault Wind
reasons: no body-paint material (mats=0, cov=0.000); body renders flat matte clay-white
panel surfaces soft and melted, roof/door shut lines undefined
headlights are featureless black voids with no internal elements
wheels render as glossy black blobs, spokes barely traceable in the 3/4 views
front bumper and grille detail smeared

name: Renault-clio
reasons: CRUMPLED BODYWORK: rear quarter panel has deep collision-like folds and the tail-light housing is torn/creased (confirmed at 3x on rear34)
body renders as mirror chrome rather than paint
CORRECTION to first impression: tyres ARE black rubber and the chrome alloys are fine - the defect is geometry, not materials

name: Renault 8 GORDINI
reasons: reads instantly as a Renault 8 Gordini; proportions, roof, pillars and wheelbase consistent across all four views
glazing reads as real glass - seats and interior visible through the screen and side windows
tyres plainly black rubber; dark 5-spoke rim faces present and consistent in all four views
bonnet, door and boot shut lines defined; chrome bumpers crisp; quad driving lamps have internal reflector detail

CAVEAT: white Gordini stripes, rally roundels and a RENAULTSPORT sun-strip are baked into the texture, and mats=9 cov=0.625 - a respray cannot produce a neutral single colour; recolour_audit --stamp must settle it before any colour-swap listing

name: Renault Arkana 2020
reasons: Arkana coupe-SUV proportions read instantly; front 3/4 strong
glazing reads as real glass; interior faintly visible through the screen
rim faces and spokes traceable in all four views
tyre reads as dark matte rubber, tonally separate from the alloy - not deep black but not body colour
door and bonnet shut lines defined; C-signature headlamps have internal elements

name: Renault estafette Pickup
reasons: proportions read as a Renault Estafette pickup instantly; strong front 3/4
glazing reads as real glass, cab interior visible
tyres plainly black rubber; rim faces and hub caps present in all four views
door and panel shut lines defined; period grille and lamps adequate

name: Renault Megane Scenic 1998
reasons: reads as a Mk1 Megane Scenic instantly; roof, pillars and wheelbase consistent across all four views
glazing genuinely transparent - seats and interior visible
tyres verified at 4x: near-black rubber with sidewall sheen, hubcap face present
NOTE panel surfaces are soft and slightly wavy on the doors; headlamp internals flat
header pose warn low-top(tob=0.422) is a false positive on an MPV, not a defect
